items.headline: U.S. Stocks End Week Strong, Driven by Tech Gains and Easing Oil Prices
items.summary: U.S. equities closed out their first winning week in three, with major indices advancing on Friday. The S&P 500, NASDAQ, and Dow Jones Industrial Average all posted solid gains, fueled by a rotation into growth stocks, particularly in the technology sector, and a notable cooldown in oil prices. Market sentiment benefited from renewed enthusiasm for artificial intelligence initiatives, though elevated Treasury yields remained a key concern.

items.headline: Dell Rallies on Analyst Upgrade
items.summary: Dell Technologies ($DELL) surged following Morgan Stanley's decision to raise its bull-case price target for the company, highlighting strong confidence in its outlook.

items.headline: ON Semiconductor Leads Chipmakers Higher
items.summary: ON Semiconductor ($ON) experienced significant gains as the information technology sector, particularly semiconductor and AI-related names, led market advances.

items.headline: Microchip Technology Posts Strong Performance
items.summary: Microchip Technology ($MCHP) saw robust performance, contributing to the broader strength in the technology sector driven by renewed interest in growth stocks.

items.headline: Zscaler Drops Among Worst Performers
items.summary: Cloud security firm Zscaler Inc. ($ZS) was among the biggest losers, experiencing a notable decline during Friday's trading session.

items.headline: Marathon Petroleum Down with Energy Sector
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corp ($MPC) declined as the energy sector lagged due to a cooldown in Brent crude oil prices.

items.headline: Diamondback Energy Hit by Oil Price Dip
items.summary: Diamondback Energy ($FANG) was down, reflecting the broader weakness in oil and gas stocks as crude prices softened.

items.headline: Information Technology Leads Sector Gains
items.summary: The Information Technology sector was the top-performing sector on Friday, registering a 0.99% gain. This strong showing was primarily driven by positive momentum in semiconductor and AI-related stocks, indicating a rotation back into growth-oriented assets.

items.headline: Energy Sector Lags as Oil Prices Cool
items.summary: Conversely, the Energy sector faced the largest drawdown, declining by 0.88%. This underperformance was largely attributed to a 2% drop in Brent crude oil prices, which settled at $104 per barrel.

items.headline: Fed Signals Continued Rate Hike Path Amid Strong Economy
items.summary: Earlier in September, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter percentage point, setting the federal funds target range to 3.75% to 4.00%. The latest 'dot plot' suggests that the median FOMC member anticipates at least one additional 25 basis point rate hike in 2026. Hawkish comments from Fed officials and a stronger-than-expected preliminary September S&P PMI, which unexpectedly rose to a five-year high, have increased the odds of further rate hikes in October.

items.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yields Jump to 2007 Highs
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield surged to 5.15% this week, reaching its highest level since 2007. This rise was influenced by concerns about potential Federal Reserve rate hikes and resilient economic data.

items.headline: Key Earnings Reports: Costco Beats, Akamai Lands Major Deal
items.summary: After Thursday's market close, Costco Wholesale Corporation ($COST) reported earnings and revenues that surpassed expectations. Separately, Akamai Technologies ($AKAM) announced an $11.6 billion seven-year cloud deal with Anthropic, leading to significant pre-market gains for Akamai.
